text: DEFONEOS — Wales Office — Welsh Devolution & Governance AI Deep-Dive Pack ⚠ EU AI Act Article 50 — Transparency & Compliance: This pack maps sovereign AI governance obligations for Welsh devolution, Senedd Cymru governance, NHS Wales, and the Well-being of Future Generations Act. High-risk classification under Annex III. Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × Wales Office × Welsh Devolution × Senedd × NHS Wales Wales Office — Welsh Devolution & Governance AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance framework for the Wales Office — covering Welsh devolution settlement, Senedd governance, NHS Wales, Welsh language revitalisation, and future generations obligations across 12 mission-critical entry points. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Devolution 1. Senedd Cymru Welsh Parliament (60 members), Senedd elections, legislative competence, Government of Wales Act 2006. Senedd Commission, committee system, and Senedd legislation pipeline. Government 2. Welsh Government First Minister and Cabinet, Programme for Government, Welsh Government departments. Ministerial code, civil service delivery, and policy development across 20+ devolved areas. Justice 3. Policing & Justice Devolution Devolution of policing and justice powers (ongoing), HMICFRS oversight of 4 Welsh forces, Police & Crime Commissioners. Justice Committee scrutiny, youth justice, and probation services. Fiscal 4. Fiscal Framework Barnett formula application, Welsh block grant (£18bn+), Welsh Rate of Income Tax, Land Transaction Tax. Fiscal framework agreement, borrowing powers, and reserve claims. Language 5. Welsh Language & Culture Welsh Language (Wales) Measure 2011, Cymraeg 2050 strategy (1m speakers), Welsh Language Commissioner. Broadcasting, cultural heritage, and education immersion. Health 6. NHS Wales NHS Wales (7 health boards, 3 trusts), Aneurin Bevan model, Welsh Ambulance Service. Health and Social Services, primary care, and waiting times management. Education 7. Education & Curriculum Curriculum for Wales, new GCSEs, Qualifications Wales, Estyn inspection. Pupil Development Grant, Education Workforce Council, and ALN reform. Economy 8. Economic Development Development Bank of Wales, Business Wales, town centre regeneration. City Deals (Cardiff Capital Region, Swansea Bay), Freeports, and trade. Environment 9. Environment & Agriculture Natural Resources Wales, Agriculture Act (Wales), Well-being of Future Generations Act. Sustainable Development Goals, net zero 2050, and land management. Transport 10. Transport & Infrastructure Transport for Wales, South Wales Metro, rail infrastructure. M4 relief road decision, 20mph default speed limit, and active travel. Housing 11. Housing & Planning Welsh housing policy, Renting Homes (Wales) Act, planning reform. Social housing, homelessness prevention, and empty homes. Accountability 12. Parliamentary Accountability Welsh Affairs Committee, Wales Questions, Westminster legislation for Wales. Secretary of State for Wales, reserved matters, and Sewel Convention. 8 Transformation Priorities Priority 1 Senedd Digital Legislature Bill passage tracking 6wk→real-time, committee evidence processing -70%. AI-assisted Senedd operations, legislative competence checking, and bilingual legislation support. Target: full digital legislative pipeline for Senedd Cymru. Priority 2 NHS Wales AI Command Patient pathway optimisation -50% waiting, resource allocation efficiency +60%. AI-driven demand forecasting across 7 health boards, elective care scheduling, and ambulance dispatch. Target: NHS Wales waiting times under 26 weeks for all treatments. Priority 3 Cymraeg 2050 Accelerator Welsh language learner engagement +80%, immersion programme targeting +40%. AI-powered language learning personalisation, workplace Welsh assessment, and public service bilingual compliance. Target: 500,000 Welsh speakers by 2030 milestone. Priority 4 Fiscal Framework Intelligence Barnett consequentia
